node.statement: Fix the data and hypotheses of node 1, fix q>=1, Y in M_q(B), and j. Put P_jq(Y):=sum_{s,t in Sigma_j} p_js p_jt iota_js,q^* W_j,q Delta_q(hat-U_js Y hat-U_jt^*) W_j,q^* iota_jt,q. Then ||(Upsilon'_j)_q(Delta_q(Y))-P_jq(Y)|| <= (C_2+C_3)*eta*||Y||.
